dashboard.name: NutsNews Backend - APM - Errors and Exceptions
dashboard.description: 24 hour dashboard for backend failure rate, exception classes, failing transactions, HTTP status errors, and recent trace context. Managed from ramideltoro/nutsnews-backend.

pages.name: Errors and exceptions
pages.description: Failure triage by rate, class, transaction, endpoint, and trace context.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE error IS true) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT count(*) FROM TransactionError WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT count(*) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' AND httpResponseCode >= '400' FACET httpResponseCode TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT count(*) FROM TransactionError WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' FACET error.class LIMIT 10 SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT count(*) FROM TransactionError WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' FACET transactionName LIMIT 10 SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT count(*), percentage(count(*), WHERE error IS true) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' FACET name LIMIT 10 SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT latest(traceId), latest(transactionName), latest(error.class) FROM TransactionError WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' FACET error.group.name LIMIT 10 SINCE 24 hours ago

rawConfiguration.text: Start with error rate, then narrow by transaction and exception class. Use trace context for request-level diagnosis. Keep direct user data out of displayed attributes.
